# Vendored Dependencies

- `gifenc.js`: gifenc 1.0.3, MIT. Browser ESM distribution from
  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gifenc@1.0.3/dist/gifenc.esm.js
  Upstream: https://github.com/mattdesl/gifenc
  License: `gifenc-LICENSE.md`.
- `lucide/`: Play, Pause and X from lucide-static 0.468.0, ISC.
  Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lucide-static@0.468.0/icons/
  License: `lucide/LICENSE`.

These assets are served locally; animation and GIF export require no CDN at runtime.
